text:
samantha: FYI customer on Private is hitting intermittent 502s + high tail latency for their text-gen endpoints since last night. They also reported an unexplained billing spike on their hosted metrics for the same window. Escalating for repro steps and a debug bundle.

jia: thanks. can you paste a sample request_id and any proxy / gateway logs you have? that helps narrow whether it's upstream or our runtime.

samantha: request IDs: req_20260316_8a7f3c, req_20260316_b2d12a, req_20260316_9f1e00. customer says TLS handshake sometimes times out then downstream 502. billing spike shows token-count jump ~03:10-04:00 UTC. attached small snippet from their NGINX error log: 
```
2026/03/16 03:12:02 [error] 1234#1234: *56789 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.1.2.3, server: api.redwood.private, request: "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.2.2.10:8080/", host: "api.redwood.private", referrer: "-"
```

eric: can we get a curl repro from customer? ask them to include headers: X-Request-ID, Authorization, Content-Type and use -v so we can see TLS. Example to share with them: 
```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.private/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: req_20260316_8a7f3c" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello","max_tokens":64}'
```

jia: also ask them to run the collector debug bundle on their private deployment host (we need collector logs + manifest + redaction map). Provide this snippet: 
```
# on customer host
redwood-collector collect --out debugbundle.tar.gz --include-logs --include-manifest --redact --redact-config /etc/redwood/redact.conf
# then run presign helper to get upload URL
redwood-collector presign --file debugbundle.tar.gz --output presign.json
```

maria-cs: they tried uploading and got 403 from presigned S3 once. So we need: collector version, node time (clock skew), presign response body, and the presign headers.

jia: good catch. common failure modes: wrong presign policy (time window mismatch), missing x-amz-content-sha256 header on our client, or regional endpoint mismatch. Ask them to paste the presign JSON and the exact curl/cli they used to PUT.

samantha: customer said redaction tool removed some headers unexpectedly; they saw raw IPs in the bundle afterward. we need to validate their redact.conf and run our local redaction check: 
```
# on our side
redwood-redact-check --config redact.conf --file debugbundle.tar.gz
```

eric: if upload fails again, ask them to scp the bundle to a temporary host we provide or use SFTP fallback. But before that, gather these repro artifacts:
- precise request_id(s) from the failing calls
- full collector logs (rotate file) and collector version output from `redwood-collector --version`
- presign json response and PUT request (curl -v)
- gateway/proxy logs (nginx/error + access) for the same request_ids
- exact local time (date -u) on the host that ran the collector
- a snippet of the collected manifest (manifest.json)

ops-bot: Incident alert linked: INC-2026-0316-42 (latency spike). Auto-flagged for Private-infra.

jia: I'll own coordinating the debug bundle uplink. next steps I'll send an encrypted upload target and a short checklist. jia: @samantha can you confirm customer is able to run the collector command and has ssh access to the host?

samantha: confirmed. they've scheduled a maintenance window atm (04:30 UTC) to run the collection. I'll share our presign endpoint and the scp fallback host.

eric: once we have the bundle, I'll run the local redaction verification and then the ingestion tool to re-run the repro in our staging private env. If we see 502s reproduced, will trace kernel/hypervisor network drop + GPU runtime logs.

maria-cs: also flagged billing team to check token attribution during the spike window. may be correlated with repeated retries from client side during timeouts.

jia: send this checklist to customer (quick copy):
1) Run curl repro with -v and include X-Request-ID header.
2) Run `redwood-collector collect --out debugbundle.tar.gz --include-logs --redact --redact-config /etc/redwood/redact.conf` during the failing request if possible.
3) Run `redwood-collector presign --file debugbundle.tar.gz` and paste the JSON.
4) Attempt upload with `curl -v -X PUT "<presigned_url>" --upload-file debugbundle.tar.gz` and paste full curl output if it fails.
5) If PUT returns 403, run `date -u` and `redwood-collector --version` and paste both.
6) If redaction looks incorrect, attach redact.conf and a small sample file (sanitized) showing the mismatch.

samantha: customer acknowledged. they're collecting the bits now. I'll post here when bundle is uploaded or scp completed.

eric: nice. once we have the bundle, I'll also check runtime kernel logs (dmesg) for any OOM or NIC resets that might cause upstream timeouts.

jia: tagging follow-ups: @maria-cs (billing), @eric (eng-oncall). :thumbsup:

samantha: thanks team. I'll update thread after upload.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0316-42 status updated: gathering artifacts.

(small follow-up later)

samantha: uploaded debugbundle.tar.gz via scp to our temp host as fallback. path: /tmp/1719999999/debugbundle.tar.gz. presign had 403 consistently. collector --version: 1.4.2. host time: 2026-03-16T04:29:58Z. Attached the presign.json and curl -v output to the support ticket.

jia: got it, pulling bundle now. I'll run redaction check and post results.

eric: thanks — will try to repro with the same request_id in staging once redact check completes.

samantha: customer says they also saw a spike in retries from a scheduled job during the window, so billing spike likely client-side loops. I've asked them to pause job after bundle.

jia: receiving bundle + logs. initial redaction check: IPs present in logs inside /var/log/app/*.log — seems redact.conf pattern missed CIDR entries. I'll run a patch locally and re-run redaction.

jia: next steps for eng: create a small repro harness using the request payload and our staging endpoint, include injected 200ms artificial latency to see retry behavior. assigning to eric.

eric: on it. will report back with repro results and timeline.

samantha: closing loop with customer and will follow up on billing once billing team confirms. :white_check_mark:
